Author: pyreymo
Name: Event Horizon
Description: Cull distant or irrelevant world objects around your character. Use /eventhorizon or /eh to open settings.
Changelog:
- Added an option to show FPS in the server info bar alongside EH: ON/OFF, making it easier to compare frame rate changes when toggling Event Horizon.
- Added an optional dark background for the server info bar. Protect your eyes, one UI element at a time.
TestingChangelog:
- Rebuilt player visibility around a deterministic, motion-aware Stable Top-B selector and a stricter admission gate, keeping crowded scenes steadier and preventing newly populated player slots from briefly flashing before selection.
- Reworked culling ownership and cleanup to handle slot reuse, suspension, configuration changes, and plugin unload more reliably.
- Added hiding for other players' battle pets and an experimental cleanup rule for certain non-targetable or dialogue-only Event NPCs. Both options are enabled by default.
- Added configurable lightweight dot markers for hidden players and players targeting you. Targeting-me markers now support nameplate, dot, and VFX modes independently.
- Added optional controls for hiding the current area's BG Part graphics and terrain rendering.
- Removed player fade animations to reduce runtime overhead; visibility changes now switch directly while player reveals remain rate-limited.
